en: A vintage black-and-white postcard showing the facade of a modest but well-maintained guesthouse with flower boxes on the windows and a polka-dot awning above the entrance. The reverse side contains printed German text advertising 'Fremdenheim Blume,' an inn located at Brunnenstraße 18 in Bad Pyrmont, with information about amenities (central heating, running hot and cold water), and a blue museum stamp for 'Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont.' The postcard also features handwritten numbers and printed publisher information.
